description.value: Howe Sound Inn & Brewing is Squamish's original craft brewery, operating since 1996 in the heart of Sea to Sky Country at the gateway to world-class mountain biking, climbing, and road cycling terrain. The flagship Squamish location combines a full-service brewpub and kitchen with an attached inn and outdoor patio, serving award-winning craft beers — the brewery was named Canadian Brewery of the Year in 2022 — alongside stone-fired pizzas and hearty pub fare. It is a natural refueling and overnight stop for cyclists on the Sea to Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler.
